## ICdcCallback type

In-process subscriber callback.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ICdcCallback = (event: ICdcEvent) => void;
```
**References:** [ICdcEvent](./lmdb.icdcevent.md)

## Remarks

Invoked per matching record on drain. A throwing callback is reported to the env's diagnostics sink and never breaks the writer's commit.
